snippet.title: MX World Tour Featuring Jamie Little - Career Mode Longplay
snippet.description:
Today is actually full of longplay again and it's MX World Tour PS2. Basic is same as MTX Mototrax, but I prefer MTX Mototrax rather than this one. 

It's a full longplay and I got tired as well.
Enjoy...!
